title: StablePay: Crypto Payment Widget to Allow Decentralized Stablecoins to be Used for Payments in Merchant Websites

ms.criteria:
・The figma design should show the StablePay widget. This should contain:
・Three stages of the checkout flow:
・"Pay with StablePay" button.
・"Select token and network" stage.
・"Submit transaction" stage.
・Proposed fonts and colors.
・Proposed texts to be used in each stage.
・The proposed fonts, colors and texts in the figma design are intended to be non-strict guidelines for the actual implementation in future milestones.
ms.report:
Here is the evidence of milestone completion:
v1: https://www.figma.com/design/qdFEFQzI6ePaegPO2CdJ6f/StablePay-Design?node-id=0-1&node-type=canvas&t=POkPS3GcZZn3eD08-0
v2: https://www.figma.com/design/ZGKUIBLGwpoLD4eAPE287e/StablePay-Changes?node-id=0-1&node-type=canvas&t=e0mthxsORq7TyVk7-0
Note that, in v1, we designed the checkout flow exactly as originally planned and as described in the acceptance criteria, with 3 stages ("Pay with StablePay" button, "Select Token and Network" modal and "Submit Transaction" modal). However, during the design process, we realized that we could improve the user experience by having a checkout process with 2 stages only ("StablePay" button and "Transaction" modal). This led us to the improved v2 design linked above as well.
For convenience, we have also included screenshots of the Figma designs in this google doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yCwiiWsL294sfR8X-T_JhGapAAVCwk-wLCD9OAjTLX0/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vbav43m2o5pd).
This concludes the evidence required for completion of Milestone 1.
We have already progressed significantly beyond milestone 1 and we would like to share evidence of this progress beyond milestone 1 as well:
・Part of the code is already available in this repo (https://github.com/DjedAlliance/StablePay)
・A demo can be seen in this video (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cD4MSXH8Qzu3ydT0gLTWpKWt8vlSYTiS/view?usp=sharing).

Thank you!

The old milestone statement, the new milestone statement and the previous proof-of-achievement are all available in the milestone module.

=======================================
